posts.title: Pythagoras: two traps to dodge
posts.planGate: Metricool Free plan: schedule only after Rej has confirmed the Starter upgrade in chat
altText: Short animated video with on-screen captions. Handwriting appears on squared paper as if written by a cartoon pen, with Em’s three coloured circles in the top corner. Opens with the title ‘Pythagoras: two traps to dodge’. Two right-angled triangles are drawn: one with shorter sides 6 cm and 8 cm and the longest side x; one with longest side 13 cm, a shorter side 5 cm and the other side y. Underneath: x² = 6² + 8² = 36 + 64 = 100. ‘x = 100’ is written in orange, the circles wobble with a ‘hmm’, and it is crossed out. Then x = √100 = 10 cm, ringed in green with a tick. Next, y² = 13² + 5² is started in orange, crossed out, and replaced with 13² − 5² = 169 − 25 = 144, so y = √144 = 12 cm, ticked. The circles celebrate. Ends with ‘Show every step.’, ‘Try Educate Me AI free · link in bio’ and the Educate Me AI logo.

platforms.label: Instagram Reel
platforms.caption:
Pythagoras, two ways. Finding the longest side (the hypotenuse)? Square the two shorter sides and add: 6² + 8² = 36 + 64 = 100. Then square root: x = √100 = 10 cm, not 100.

Finding a shorter side? Subtract instead: 13² − 5² = 169 − 25 = 144, so y = √144 = 12 cm. Write every step, because working can earn marks even if the final answer slips.

posts.title: Double brackets: every term counts
posts.planGate: Metricool Free plan: schedule only after Rej has confirmed the Starter upgrade in chat
altText: Short animated video with on-screen captions. Handwriting appears on squared paper as if written by a cartoon pen, with Em’s three coloured circles in the top corner. Opens with the title ‘Double brackets: every term counts’. First, (x + 3)(x + 5) = x² + 15 is written, with ‘= x² + 15’ in orange; the circles wobble with a ‘hmm’ and it is crossed out. Underneath: = x² + 5x + 3x + 15, note ‘4 terms’, then = x² + 8x + 15, ringed in green with a tick, note ‘collect like terms’. Next: (x + 4)(x − 2) = x² − 2x + 4x − 8, note ‘4 × −2 = −8’, then = x² + 2x − 8, ticked. The circles celebrate. Ends with ‘Show every step.’, ‘Try Educate Me AI free · link in bio’ and the Educate Me AI logo.

platforms.label: Instagram Reel
platforms.caption:
Expanding double brackets. (x + 3)(x + 5) is not x² + 15. Multiply every term in the first bracket by every term in the second: x² + 5x + 3x + 15. Then collect like terms: x² + 8x + 15.

Watch the signs: (x + 4)(x − 2) = x² − 2x + 4x − 8 = x² + 2x − 8. Write every step, because working can earn marks even if the final answer slips.
